TABLE.NAME: local_ai_content_cache
TABLE.COMMENT: Cache for extracted text from files to avoid repeated expensive AI calls

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA1 content hash of the original file

FIELD.NAME: extractedcontent
FIELD.COMMENT: Text extracted from the file by AI or converter

TABLE.NAME: local_ai_content_sources
TABLE.COMMENT: Table storing all AI content sources

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Moodle context this source is attached to (system, category, course or module)

FIELD.NAME: sourcetype
FIELD.COMMENT: One of source::TYPE_* (module, document, external)

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional human-readable description of the source

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Related course module id for module sources

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: Inline plain-text content for document sources

FIELD.NAME: externalfilter
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON filter identifying the vectors of an external source inside its vector store instance

FIELD.NAME: externalcollection
FIELD.COMMENT: Backend name of the collection holding the vectors of an external source

FIELD.NAME: externalmodel
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the embedding model which created the vectors of an external source

FIELD.NAME: citation
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON source-level citation metadata (title, url, author, publisher, date, license, locatortype)

FIELD.NAME: vecstoreid
FIELD.COMMENT: The local_ai_manager_vecstore instance holding the vectors of this source

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this source participates in RAG retrieval

FIELD.NAME: allowindex
FIELD.COMMENT: Is the content allowed to be indexed

TABLE.NAME: local_ai_content_index
TABLE.COMMENT: Index of a source for one embedding model, the vectors live in the collection of this model

FIELD.NAME: sourceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to local_ai_content_sources.id

FIELD.NAME: embeddingmodel
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the embedding model the source is indexed with

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Indexing status (queued, running, indexed, failed)

FIELD.NAME: taskid
FIELD.COMMENT: Last queued adhoc task ID used to index the source with this model

FIELD.NAME: error
FIELD.COMMENT: Error message of the last failed indexing run

FIELD.NAME: debuginfo
FIELD.COMMENT: Technical details of the last failed indexing run, only filled while developer debugging is enabled

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the last indexed content, used for change detection

FIELD.NAME: lastindexed
FIELD.COMMENT: The timestamp of the last successful indexing run

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who started the last indexing run and pays for its embedding requests

TABLE.NAME: local_ai_content_ctx_sources
TABLE.COMMENT: Junction table mapping which sources are activated for RAG in a given context

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: The context in which the source is activated for RAG retrieval

FIELD.NAME: sourceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to local_ai_content_sources.id
